scope: five milling machines; 300 mm renewed-zero squareness and 300 mm diameter renewed-front-zero sweep; main matrix A=C=0 plus seven separate rotary states; physical support-derived expectation
limitations: Fixed-mount old-zero indication is undefined in the product because physical fixture mounting points and axial arm length are not specified.
Finite table contact is independently checked for seven ideal five-axis rotary states; the main matrix separately reports product contact flags.
Ritz bending and portal seat assumptions are audited teaching geometry, not machine elasticity.
